name: feature-hero

frames.best_why: Headline, pitch and all five feature cards fit in one view, with the raised middle card visible.

tagline: Five AI feature blurbs around a blue glow, middle card enlarged.
summary: A centred heading and paragraph over five icon features: three across the top, two beneath. The middle item is scaled up with a filled blue icon to mark it as the key one.
appearance: A white page with faint diagonal pinstripes and a blue glow rising from the bottom edge. A centred headline and grey paragraph sit above five features arranged three then two, each with a small round icon over a bold title and short grey description.
behaviour: The heading and cards fade up into place once as the section enters the viewport. The middle feature keeps a larger filled blue icon and slight scale, while the others lighten their icon circle on hover.
demo_content: Headline 'Empower Your Business with AI-Driven Precision' with cards such as AI Campaign Optimization.
search_phrases: ai features with round icons in a grid
centered headline above five feature blurbs
feature list three on top two below
light section with diagonal stripe texture
icon features with highlighted middle card
blue glow at bottom of white section
use_when: Five short capabilities need an even, centred layout with one highlighted as the strongest.
avoid_when: Feature copy is baked into the file, and the pale stripes plus glow assume a light page.
customise: Titles, descriptions and icon choices come from the features array; the stripe angle and blue glow stops are in the section classes.
weight_why: Five static cards with one fade-up; the backdrop is pure CSS.

a11y.note: Nothing is focusable, so the hover highlight is decorative only, and reduced motion is never checked.

issues: The five features are fixed in the source, with no way to pass a different list.
Feature icons are unlabelled SVGs; only the adjacent titles carry the meaning.
polish_why: Even spacing and a distinctive glow-and-stripe backdrop; the middle emphasis is subtle.
